operating_notes.text: FY26 exceptional item of ₹79.26 mn relates to the four Labour Codes notified on November 21, 2025, mainly from a change in wage definition.
Capital work-in-progress stood at ₹559.79 Cr at Mar-2026 against fixed assets of ₹626.74 Cr, indicating a large expansion under way.
The company operates a single segment (forging and engineering quality carbon and alloy steels) and includes its proportionate share of Hospet Steels Limited, a joint operation.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹484.39 Cr (-11.0% YoY), net profit ₹71.68 Cr (-10.6% YoY).
